mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO MoM < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2%, it indicates a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor market conditions, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS MoM > 0% and UNRATE MoM < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real estate sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS MoM > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals supply-side constraints and inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO MoM < 0% and CPIAUCSL MoM > 0.5%.
